Game Overview

Dunk Hoop is a sports title where engage in basketball from an exciting new perspective as you become the hoop. Test your speed and precision by catching basketballs, aiming for perfect baskets to boost your score. With fast-paced action and simple mechanics, Dunk Hoop offers addictive gameplay that keeps you striving for the high score.
